mathematical_contract.projective_pair_predicates: For coordinates N(a)/D(a) and M(b)/E(b), every linear order, chord orientation, and circle residual clears D and E exactly. Physical signs are restored from certified denominator signs; squared circle denominators require no orientation correction.
mathematical_contract.selected_field_diagonal: Structurally equal selected parameters denote the same isolated root, so a bivariate predicate is specialized on b=a before interval boxing or multi-field reduction. Unequal retained parameters continue through strict bivariate refinement and the existing exact selected-pair authority.
mathematical_contract.arc_membership: A cusp fragment is a minor subarc of one certified semicircle. Supporting-circle incidence plus the traversal-aware endpoint chord half-plane selects that subarc exactly, including endpoints.
mathematical_contract.ray_selection: Each retained fragment contributes at most two endpoint-collinear forbidden slopes. Testing 2n+1 exact integer slopes therefore finds an admissible ray for an off-boundary query whenever endpoint inequality is decidable.
mathematical_contract.winding: Native and algebraic circular carriers share one half-open minor-arc decision table. The ray basis is x=dot(d,p), y=cross(d,p), so arbitrary rational d preserves the standard positive horizontal-ray winding proof.
mathematical_contract.boundary_side: A unary side ray originates at a representative strictly inside its source cusp subarc. A line through one circle point meets that circle only there and at its antipode, which lies outside the same open semicircle. Skipping the certified source fragment removes exactly the origin contact and no forward crossing.
mathematical_contract.structural_support: Cusp fragments sharing one retained frame and equal radius squared have the same supporting circle. A source-boundary representative therefore has zero circle residual on such a fragment without replaying a selected-root resultant.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts exact proof only. APPROXIMATE_512 traverses the identical graph and can terminate only at the shared Hyperlimit 512-bit predicate boundary; returned carriers and topology remain exact.
mathematical_contract.failure: Mapped multi-field endpoints, an unresolved bivariate zero, a degenerate ray, contradictory loop semantics, or an unsupported coefficient tower remains explicit. No f64 projection, tolerance, uncorrelated root matching, or primitive-element approximation is used.

Nested all-cusp disks complete one authoritative topology and all four Booleans, while non-rational unary cusp representatives classify both boundary sides without materialization.
capability.bounded_failure: A cusp fragment whose endpoint is a mapped algebraic parameter rather than Exact(Real) remains explicit Unsupported in the ray evaluator pending a three-field endpoint authority.
